name: n8n
tagline: Code-first automation you can self-host, for technical teams
description: Open source automation platform that combines 400+ ready-made integrations with JavaScript or Python, running in the cloud or on your own server.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Technical teams that need AI inside the flow and control of the server
pros: Open source and self-hosted: your data never leaves your infrastructure and server costs stay predictable
Visual editor that accepts JavaScript or Python when the ready-made connector does not solve the case
Billed per execution, not per task, which favors long flows with many internal steps
Large community, thorough documentation and hundreds of ready-made templates to adapt
cons: Steep learning curve for non-programmers: expressions, JSON and webhooks are frequent traps
Execution billing punishes looping and AI-heavy flows, because every iteration counts as a new execution
Self-hosting requires someone responsible for Docker, backups, logs and version upgrades
Documentation and support are English-only; reliable material in other languages is scarce

features.name: Visual flow editor
features.detail: Steps, branches and loops on drag and drop, with code on demand

features.name: 400+ ready integrations
features.detail: Connectors for CRM, ERP, email, WhatsApp and AI providers

features.name: AI agents with tools
features.detail: Agents that call APIs and internal flows over HTTP Request

features.name: Self-hosted open source
features.detail: Community edition is free with unlimited executions; the paid license is separate

features.name: Community and templates
features.detail: Active forum, hundreds of ready flows and community plugins

features.name: Scheduling and webhooks
features.detail: Triggers on cron, app events or HTTP requests coming from another system

useCases: Generate a PDF quote and register the lead in the CRM as soon as the website form is submitted
Extract data from PDF invoices and post the receivable to the finance system every week
Send the customer a WhatsApp message the moment the order goes out for delivery
Consolidate sales from spreadsheets, marketplaces and WhatsApp into a single dashboard updated daily
bestForWho: Companies with someone technical on the team that want to automate real processes, with AI in the middle, without depending on a proprietary platform.
verdict: n8n is the best choice when the automation needs real AI in the middle of the flow and someone in the company understands a bit of code. In one client we worked with, a flow that calls a model API saved roughly 40 hours of manual spreadsheet work every month; the same design on Zapier would cost more and run slower. What gets in the way is not the price, it is maintenance: whoever installs self-hosted has to own backups, image updates and log reading. For a small company with no technical team, start on the cloud plan and migrate to self-hosted only when execution volume justifies it. For a larger company, self-hosted with a paid license and a clearly named owner is the only scenario that sustains high volume without a nasty surprise on the invoice.
